rows.title: Signed cents
rows.defect: the minus sign is read and then dropped, so a $12.34 debit reads as money coming in

rows.title: The bank's own as-of time
rows.defect: epoch seconds are read as milliseconds, so every balance is dated January 1970
rows.test: balance-date in epoch seconds is 17:00 UTC that day

rows.title: Other currencies keep their raw amount
rows.defect: the USD-only guard is dropped, so euros are counted as dollars
rows.test: EUR 950.00 is not 95000 cents

rows.title: A balance from after the fetch is not current
rows.defect: the future-timestamp guard is dropped
rows.test: a balance stamped one second after the fetch has no as-of

rows.title: A balance stamped at the fetch is current
rows.defect: the guard is off by one: a balance stamped at the fetch second is called future
rows.test: a balance stamped exactly at the fetch keeps its as-of

rows.title: No fetch time, nothing kept
rows.defect: the fetch-time guard is dropped
rows.test: a batch without fetched_at is refused

rows.title: A repeated account stops the batch
rows.defect: account ids are not checked for repeats
rows.test: the same account id twice is refused

rows.title: A repeated transaction stops the batch
rows.defect: transaction ids are not checked for repeats
rows.test: one id with -$15.49 and -$1.00 is refused

rows.title: A posted row needs a date
rows.defect: a posted row without a date is let through
rows.test: a posted row with no date is refused

rows.title: Unreadable dollars stop the batch
rows.defect: an unreadable USD amount is kept as null
rows.test: -12.345 is refused, not kept as unknown

rows.title: The bank's errors stay readable
rows.defect: each error is stringified, so SimpleFIN 2 errors read "[object Object]" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: {code, msg} reads "con.auth: Reauthenticate with Mock Bank"

rows.title: Bank text never makes a transfer
rows.defect: transfer words in the bank text mark a transfer
rows.test: AUTOPAY and ZELLE rows are not transfers

rows.title: Pending links on the same account only
rows.defect: the account check is dropped from the link
rows.test: a pending row on savings does not link to a checking post

rows.title: An inferred bill is asserted
rows.defect: a bank pattern is stored as a verified bill
rows.test: the Netflix pattern is asserted, never verified

rows.title: Every two weeks, 13 to 15 days
rows.defect: the two-week window ends before 15 days
rows.test: gaps of 15 and 14 days are every two weeks

rows.title: Due today still counts
rows.defect: a bill due today is treated as past
rows.test: a bill expected Oct 12 is kept on Oct 12

rows.title: 32 days is still monthly
rows.defect: the monthly window ends before 32 days
rows.test: Jun 30, Aug 1, Sep 1 is monthly

rows.title: $1.00 tolerance
rows.defect: the tolerance floor is 10 cents instead of $1.00

rows.title: Transfers never make a bill
rows.defect: provider-labeled transfers are grouped as bills
rows.test: three monthly provider transfers are no bill

rows.title: The person's account type wins
rows.defect: the bank's kind is read before the person's
rows.test: savings the person named counts; checking they called investment does not

rows.title: Exactly 24 hours still counts
rows.defect: the freshness limit excludes exactly 24 hours
rows.test: a balance 24h old is fresh, 24h + 1ms is stale

rows.title: Overdrawn subtracts
rows.defect: an overdrawn balance is added as positive

rows.title: Only verified bills are known due
rows.defect: asserted bank guesses are added to the amount due
rows.test: an asserted $15.49 guess is not in the $94.32 due

rows.title: Other-currency bills are counted
rows.defect: bills in another currency are dropped without a count (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a CAD bill is counted as not included

rows.title: No cash account is unknown, not $0
rows.defect: an empty sum is reported as $0.00
rows.test: no usable account gives null
